lens: evidence integrity, provenance, privacy, authorization, and reversible action
strengths: The draggable clause springs back into its exact source sentence, so direct manipulation changes proposal scope without visually severing provenance.
The product object preserves source type, synthetic identity, speaker context, timestamp, assignment context, before and after state, and uncertainty.
Confirm facts and Approve separately are distinct controls; the external action remains disabled and explicitly requires separate review.
Removing the remote-flexibility clause retracts its derived work-mode state and revises the dependency instead of leaving an unsupported recommendation behind.
The page explicitly labels the example synthetic, describes the current status as a working prototype, and declines to assert customer outcomes or autonomous execution.
Privacy and deletion language stays at the repository-supported design-intent level and links to the public privacy page.
